subject.title: fix(test): make broad shard execution deterministic

question: Should the migration-precedence and Telegram direct-chat behavior fixes land together with the broad-shard reliability work, or should either user-facing change be separated for owner review?
rationale: The PR is coherent around failures found by broad execution, but it changes persisted-config migration precedence and a visible Telegram action capability; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner judgment on scope and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Land as one reviewed reliability fix
options.body: Confirm the covered migration precedence and direct-chat-only Telegram behavior are the intended contracts, then merge the cohesive broad-shard repair.

options.title: Split user-facing behavior
options.body: Move the migration and/or Telegram fixes into focused follow-up PRs if their owner review or live proof should be independent of test-runner hardening.

recommendation.title: Land as one reviewed reliability fix
recommendation.body: Confirm the covered migration precedence and direct-chat-only Telegram behavior are the intended contracts, then merge the cohesive broad-shard repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author is the available routing signal for the coupled implementation and its stated validation evidence.
